svg.text: MPx-BLM-015/016/021/006 · Jug, cap, top plate, insulation sleeve
MPx Boil-Loop Mini v0.5 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. P15 by scientific glassblower: wall 3.0 ±0.3, chimney fused at x 15.5, outlet boss Ø16 at x −25 for a 1/4" SS bulkhead + VMQ washers.
2. Usable volume to the 0.5 L mark ≈ 0.53 L; graduations every 100 mL (enamel print).
3. P21 top plate carries the jug on a 2.0 VMQ gasket ring; P16 cap is a loose lid with a Ø18 vent over the chimney.
4. P06 sleeve: closed-cell silicone foam 2.0, wrapped round P05 and butt-joined with silicone tape.
closed-cell silicone foam t 2.0; wraps P05 (OD 73.5) to Ø77.5
